ev.q: During a 4-month period in 1999, ImpacTeen researchers observed POP environments in 3,031 retail outlets
Exterior tobacco advertisements were observed in 58.9% of the stores
Tobacco-control signage was observed in 65.8% of the stores
Convenience/gas retailers were significantly more likely to have five of the six POP measures

methods_quotes.q: Data were weighted to account for both the community-level multistage sampling procedures and the store selection probabilities.
generalized estimating equations that accounted for community clustering while specifying a binomial distribution and a logit link function
Results were expressed as unadjusted odds ratios and 95% Wald confidence intervals.
